methods.description: Leave out multiplication signs between factors.
Place the numerical factor before the pronumerals.
Hide1 while retaining any negative sign.
Count identical factors to write a power.
Keep dividend on top and the entire nonzero divisor underneath.
Read concise products, powers and fractions back into explicit operations.
Apply several notation conventions together without changing operations.
Read and write multiplication of a whole bracket, without distributing.
